entities.summary: Sebastián is a Mexican sculptor best known for his monumental works of steel and/or concrete in both Mexico and abroad. These include a number of “gate” sculptures such as the Gran Puerta a México in Matamoros, Tamaulipas, but his most famous sculpture is El Caballito located in downtown Mexico City. His works are found in various countries outside Mexico, such as Japan where two are now used as city symbols.
